summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of PT. Dira Baraka Mulia React landing page. Verified all 21 features in the review request — home page sections, language switcher (EN default + ID toggle + persistence), 6/10/9/5/4 counts for services/commodities/portfolio/process/legality, floating WhatsApp button, blog index with featured + 5 grid posts, blog post routing, bilingual title/body switching, **bold** markdown rendered as <strong>, Google Maps iframe with Grand+Jati+Junction, Indonesia SVG with city dots, contact form fields, anchor scroll from home and from blog page, mobile menu toggle, and reveal-on-scroll animations. No console errors detected. Implementation matches the spec end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: LanguageContext default language: spec says 'Default language is English on first visit (no localStorage)'. Current implementation reads localStorage and falls back to 'en' on first visit, which works for first visit but persists across sessions. This matches the implicit user expectation and is fine.

Contact form submit uses window.open with 'noopener' which works in real browsers; some headless popup-blockers may suppress this — verified by code inspection that the wa.me URL is correctly built with encoded prefilled body.
blogPosts.js, translations.js, and Home.jsx remain reasonably small (<700 lines). No DRY violations noted.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes — testability is excellent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is frontend-only React landing page on https://multilang-web-studio.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend is not used at all (FastAPI present but irrelevant). Key data-testids: hero-section, services-section (6 cards service-card-0..5), commodities-section (10 commodity-0..9), portfolio-section (9 portfolio-item-0..8), process-section (5 process-step-0..4), legality-section (4 legality-card-0..3), reach-section, contact-section, contact-form, form-{name,company,phone,email,service,message,submit}, office-map-iframe, floating-wa-btn, language-switcher with lang-en-btn / lang-id-btn (active class indicates selection), nav-{services,commodities,portfolio,legality,blog,contact}, mobile-menu-toggle + mobile-menu, featured-post (link to /blog/panduan-undername-impor-2025), blog-card-{slug} for the OTHER 5 posts in the grid, blog-article-body, back-to-blog. Lang persists via localStorage key 'dbm_lang'. Contact form submit opens wa.me in a new tab (window.open with noopener) — Playwright's expect_popup may not catch noopener popups, verify via code inspection if needed. Reveal animations: elements with .reveal class get .is-visible when scrolled into view. Indonesia SVG map renders inside reach-section with markers for Medan, Jakarta, Surabaya, Balikpapan, Makassar, Manado, Jayapura.

tests_executed.contact_form_submit_builds_wa_me_url: verified by code inspection (window.open with noopener may not trigger Playwright popup detection)
